notes.title: 【Weekly Update!】Ver2024/10/14
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who is participating in Early Access!

I am morihiko, the director of Shizuku.
This week, we have made changes to the conversation screen to improve the production aspect of the game, as well as fixing other high priority issues.


Also, thank you very much for your various postings on X (Twitter), your live performance on YouTube, and your reviews!
It is a great encouragement for our development.
(As a side note, once we reach 10 or more reviews on Steam, the game will appear in the Steam store, so if you haven't done so yet, we would appreciate your cooperation.)


==========Update details: ==========
[Additions]
・Changed the size and design of the conversation window.
・Changed the SE for the conversation.
・Test placement of “Daruma Otoshi”.


[Fixes]
・Fixed a bug that the game freezes when entering the 8th map.
・Fixed a bug that caused the loading screen to appear indefinitely.
・Fixed a bug that the loading screen would freeze if the player jumped over the enemy while the enemy was chasing the player.


[Fixes currently being addressed]
・Fixed a bug that Enemy freezes when jumping over a player when he/she is chasing the player.
→Please wait a little longer!

・Fixed a bug that the spear Akaoni does not die in some cases.


[How far can we play?]
We are about to enter the "village of demons".
(→ We hope to implement all the conversations in the "village of demons" by the end of this month.

===========================

notes.title: 【Small Bug Fix】 ver2024/10/02
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased the game, even during Early Access!

This is morihiko, the director of "Shizuku".

We have prioritized and fixed critical bugs for the time being.

Thank you so much for reporting bugs via Twitter, Discord, and the Steam community.


[Bug Fixes]
The following issues have been addressed:

Bug #3: Fixed the issue where flags were not working correctly after dying once.
Bug #7: Fixed the issue where a debug key for stage transitions was unintentionally left in.

=================================================


Although it's still under construction, we plan to share information on known bugs via the following page in the future:
https://rabbitlyentertainment.notion.site/Bugs-93fcf58a9c0c44ea9a4f0c6d0e9a829a?pvs=74


In addition, you did not tell us about the volume you envision for the upcoming Shinkara no Shizuku on Steam,
We assume that the full version will be 20 times the volume of the currently implemented story.

We hope to make it that far in roughly six months, and this title will be released on Nintendo Switch in the future.

If you play it, we would appreciate it if you could also include a Steam review!


We will continue fixing bugs and diligently developing towards the full release, so we appreciate your continued support!
